The set $A$ contains all positive integers less than $20$ that are congruent to $3$ modulo $4$.
The set $B$ contains all the prime numbers less than $20$.
(a) (i) Write down all the elements of $A$ and all the elements of $B$.
(ii) Determine the symmetric difference, $A \Delta B$, of the sets $A$ and $B$. [4]
(b) The set $C$ is defined as $C = \{7, 9, 13, 19\}$.
(i) Write down all the elements of $A \cap B$, $A \cap C$ and $B \cup C$.
(ii) Hence by considering $A \cap (B \cup C)$, verify that in this case the operation $\cap$ is distributive over the operation $\cup$. [6]
